text:
Lena Ortiz: ran into duplicate side-effects during onboarding e2e when token rotated during a 429 backoff. single checkout produced two downstream webhooks.

Omar Malik: can you paste the minimal logs/repro?

Lena Ortiz: steps: start sampleapp, click checkout, rotate creds with `./scripts/rotate_creds.sh` while client is backing off, jitter disabled in test. logs: 
```
2026-03-24T11:05:01Z INFO req=tx1 status=429
2026-03-24T11:05:01Z INFO backoff=150ms jitter=0 req=tx1
2026-03-24T11:05:02Z WARN token rotated during backoff
2026-03-24T11:05:02Z INFO req=tx1 status=200 side_effect=applied
2026-03-24T11:05:03Z INFO req=tx1_retry status=200 side_effect=applied  <-- duplicate
```

Ben Harper: sounds like Idempotency-Key was dropped on the resumed request. which SDK variant?

Lena Ortiz: node sampleapp v0.11.0 using node-sdk v0.10.2. the resume path rebuilds headers after refresh and doesn't copy Idempotency-Key into the new request.

Omar Malik: parity gap. proposal: (1) SDKs persist Idempotency-Key and a small set of tracing headers through token refresh/resume, (2) enable jitter=true by default for 429/backoff, (3) sampleapp ships `safe_replay_window_ms=9000` by default and a CI chaos test that flips creds.

Ben Harper: agree. server-side safety: add short dedupe TTL that aligns with safe_replay_window_ms. clients opt to set longer windows if they need.

Lena Ortiz: i'll open a small PR for node that stashes idempotency in retry context and merges it back after refresh. will add `./scripts/run_replay_test.sh` to repro.

sdk-bot: created DEVEX-1210 "persist idempotency through resume" and linked to ci job devex/sampleapp#replay-check

Omar Malik: telemetry note: emit metric `sdk.replay.detected` with sdk=node|python|go and reason=token_rotate. alert if duplicates spike.

Ben Harper: docs blurb: "If your flow rotates tokens during requests, ensure Idempotency-Key is durable across refresh events. SDKs will preserve it by default."

Lena Ortiz: tiny decision needed: should SDKs also preserve arbitrary user headers like X-Correlation-Id? i'd say only Idempotency-Key + X-Correlation-Id by default, and expose whitelist.

Omar Malik: whitelist approach sounds good. ok to proceed with 9s default window; we can tune using production telemetry after rollout.

Lena Ortiz: PR opened: github.com/redwood/devex/node-sdk/pull/333. i'll add unit + e2e chaos tests. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
